name: Chamomile Blossom

yarn.description: Fine cotton yarn for the raised centre
Fine cotton yarn for the petals

gauge: Gauge is not critical; use a firm tension so the centre remains rounded and the petals hold their shape.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: With yellow, make an MR; work 8 sc in MR. Join with sl st to first sc.

steps.label: Rnd 2
steps.text: Ch 1; work 1 puff in each st around. Join with sl st to first puff. Fasten off yellow.

steps.label: Petal rnd
steps.text: Join white with sl st in the top of any puff. Ch 5, hdc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in next ch, sl st in next puff; rep this petal sequence 7 times to make 8 petals.

finishing: Fasten off the white yarn, leaving a short tail.
Weave in the white and yellow yarn tails on the back of the flower.
Gently spread the petals evenly around the raised centre.
notes: puff: Yarn over, insert hook in the indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop to hdc height; repeat twice more, yarn over and draw through all 7 loops on hook.
For a slightly more rounded centre, pull the magic ring closed firmly before working Rnd 2.
